description_full:
💗 WE'RE HIRING! 💗

Calling all passionate, creative, and energetic young talents! ✨

Heavenly Blush is looking for a Marketing Intern!

Are you someone who loves marketing, enjoys meeting new people, has strong leadership skills, and is excited to create impactful offline events? This is your chance to grow, learn, and gain hands-on experience with industry professionals! 💼

📍 Placement: Yogyakarta & Medan
⏳ Internship Period: 3–6 Months
🎁 Benefits:

* Paid internship
* Certificate of internship
* Mentorship from industry professionals

📅 Apply before: 31 December 2026

Ready to be part of our journey? Send your resume to:

📩 derry.magista@heavenlyblush.com

Email format: Location_MarketingRepresentative_Name

Don't forget to attach your latest photo!

Your next career journey starts here. Let's grow together with Heavenly Blush! 💕
